en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a manor-like building with a hipped roof, dormer windows, and a small tower with a cupola and weather vane. The structure is set on a hillside with terraced vineyards or slopes in the background and a formal balustraded stairway and garden in the foreground. Printed red captions identify the scene and publisher: the main caption at the bottom right reads "Schloss Hoflößnitz," and smaller text at the lower left reads "4264 Brück & Sohn, Meissen."
